purpose: The viewfinder's colours after y2s43 (run q10hx: even brightness, hot pink where the scene is bright, green where it is dark, on every camera, zooming or not). libredwoodair.dylib only; Nord2Metal stays the installed y2s43 one. Cause: Metal's format 540 (RGB8_420_2P) has luma in GREEN, Cb in blue and Cr in red; the Mali samples the two planes as Y, Cb, Cr in red, green, blue and y2s42 handed that order over, so VideoToolbox's transfer -- which since y2s43 succeeds and is used for every preview picture, not only while the zoom moves -- wrote Cb as luma, Cr as Cb and luma as Cr. Fix: the sampler view of a 540 texture is swizzled (red <- Cr, green <- Y, blue <- Cb); format 500 and CoreAnimation's path are not touched. Also: up to 512 accepted compute modules a process are kept in /private/var/db/nord2-metal/kept (64 was not enough to reach the viewfinder's kernel in mediaserverd). Previous file kept as /private/var/db/nord2-metal/libredwoodair.dylib.pre-vt4; receipt.json inventory updated. Undo: guest-vt4-undo.sh.
